  consumes: [{subject: auth.verifyJWT, queue: auth-service}]
  produces: [user.create-user, rbac.assign-role, rbac.checkRole]
delivery_note: Signup profile and role calls are synchronous required acknowledgements; OAuth coordination returns failures.
signup_role_proof:
  application_contract: AUTH_RBAC_STUDENT_PROVISIONING_V1
  envelope: [key_id, payload, signature]
  algorithm: Ed25519
  key_id: auth-signup-v1
  purpose: signup-student-provisioning-v1
  issuer: ms-go-auth
  audience: ms-go-rbac
  principal: reserved canonical Auth UUID
  operation: persisted signup operation UUID
  role: student
  scope: existing fixed user/default-tenant/default-service/global/default-resource tuple
  lifetime_seconds: 60
  private_key_config: AUTH_RBAC_SIGNUP_PRIVATE_KEY
  missing_key: signup unavailable without unsigned fallback
